title: Colonial violence in India
lede: East India Company conquest and British Crown rule, 1757–1947: wars of annexation, adivasi and peasant risings, colonial massacres, famine, and the independence movement.

title: Armed conflict in India
lede: Interstate wars, insurgencies, communal massacres, environmental conflicts, and terrorist attacks since 1947. The Northeast is mapped as a region.

title: Income, survival, and power
lede: Per-capita NSDP and infant mortality of Indian states, read against Union cabinets, chief ministers, and sourced political events.

title: Public works in India, 1947–now
lede: Dams, steel towns, ports, highways, metros, nuclear stations, space centres and new towns after independence.
